note: One e-mail for a new shop (owner rule 26-Nov-2026): the welcome kit carries the signed seller agreements (follow-up to PR #605 and #600).

features.feature: One e-mail for a new shop: the welcome kit carries the signed seller agreements (no separate signed-copy mail)

scenarios.title: A new shop gets one e-mail: banners and signed agreements together
scenarios.description: With seller agreements on, a new shop's welcome kit carries its signed agreements; a separate signed copy is sent only when the kit had already gone out.

cases.title: New shop signed + fee paid + live → exactly one e-mail: welcome kit with banners and the signed agreement PDFs (CC), logged in My Agreements
cases.steps:
1. Sign the agreements
2. Pay the registration fee; the shop goes live
3. Replay the fee hook
4. Deliver the outbox
cases.expected: One e-mail ('… is now live on GoKesari.com') with both banners and the signed SLA in EN/MR/HI, CC to sellerAgreements.ccEmails; no separate 'signed agreements' e-mail; My Agreements send log shows it SENT

cases.title: Live shop without a welcome kit row: the fee hook queues the kit, which carries the signed PDFs
cases.preconditions: Shop live before the safety-net date, no kit row
cases.steps:
1. Shop live, no kit
2. Sign (REGISTRATION), fee paid
3. Deliver
cases.expected: One welcome kit with the three signed PDFs

cases.title: Kit already sent before the owner signed: the signed copy follows on its own without banners; the banner update never carries agreements
cases.preconditions: Staff registered the shop; it went live and got its kit before the owner signed
cases.steps:
1. Shop live, kit delivered
2. Owner signs
3. Deliver
4. Admin 'Resend updated banner'
cases.expected: One 'signed agreements' e-mail with the three PDFs and no banners; the banner update has no agreement PDFs

cases.title: Over the e-mail size limit: English agreement stays attached, Marathi and Hindi become secure links
cases.steps:
1. Large signed PDFs
2. Shop goes live
3. Deliver
cases.expected: English PDF attached; MR/HI as /api/agreements/files links (30 days) in HTML and text; log marks them linked

cases.title: The welcome kit carrying the signed agreements ends DEAD → the signed copy is sent on its own (once)
cases.preconditions: SMTP keeps rejecting the welcome kit
cases.steps:
1. Sign, pay, go live
2. The kit fails until DEAD
3. Deliver
cases.expected: One 'signed agreements' e-mail with the three PDFs (no banners); its own retries and admin alert apply
